lines.en: Blue wings drift past the birches.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，蓝翅膀最好认。
lines.en: In a birch wood, blue wings stand out.
My wings feel heavy; I'll drift a bit more.
Blue wings in the birch wood.
I could swim this stretch blind.
I fly low, afraid the wind will take me.
A leaf keeps following me.
Follow my blue—don't lose it.
I rest on birch bark first.
The underside of a birch leaf is calmer.

lines.zh: 我沿着桦树梢，一路滑过去。
lines.en: I glide along the birch tops the whole way.
Who scattered pollen all over?
I've circled this birch stand three times.
Past this row of birches, I'll rest.
This same birch—I've seen it before.

lines.zh: 这条沉船，什么时候挪来的？
lines.en: When did this wreck get moved here?

lines.zh: 白桦林里，我的蓝最打眼。
lines.en: In the birch wood my blue stands out.
The scent of birch bark is faint.
I rest on a leaf tip a while.
I'm waiting for the sunlight to fall.
Nectar or birch sap?
The birch bark glares back at me.

lines.zh: 桦木的影子，落在我翅膀上。
lines.en: Birch shadows fall across my wings.
The wind stops; the whole wood goes still.

lines.zh: 我是蝴蝶，可这片水在叫我。
lines.en: I am a butterfly, yet this water calls me.
On the leaf tip, I don't move at all.

lines.zh: 穿过一片白桦，我歇在这一朵上。
lines.en: Across the birches I rest on this one bloom.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的蓝，比水还亮。
lines.en: The blue on my wings outshines the water.
Which white blossom did I count up to?
The tree shadow moved; I haven't.

lines.zh: 我落在桦木皮上，颜色刚好。
lines.en: I land on birch bark, my color matches exactly.
Don't put your foot on those flowers.
In the birch wood, you stand out.
You're covered in birch fluff.

lines.zh: 你抬手的动作，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw your hand start to rise.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，花都被挡了。
lines.en: You're standing too close — you're blocking the flowers.
No wings—how did you get up here?
The branch you snapped was loud.

lines.zh: 你的泡泡比我的翅膀大。
lines.en: Your bubble is so much bigger than my wings.

lines.zh: 桦木林里，我的蓝色最显眼。
lines.en: In the birch forest, my blue stands out.
My wing membrane is crumpled. Can't turn.
I have not found a flower to rest on.
My wings won't beat—it hurts.
I should hide in a birch-bark crack.
A patch of blue is gone from my wing tip.
A white scratch runs across my wing.
My wing base got twisted.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一碰就掉鳞粉。
lines.en: One touch and my wing dust falls.
I need to climb higher and breathe.
A corner of my wing is torn.
Why is that flower moving?
It smells like flower, and like fruit.

lines.zh: 让我把口器探进花心里。
lines.en: Let me probe the flower's heart with my proboscis.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的蓝翅跟一步。
lines.en: One step from you, one from my blue wings.

lines.zh: 桦木林的白皮底下，虫子最肥。
lines.en: Under birch bark the grubs grow fat.
Something sweet curls around my antennae.
That bit in your palm—give it to me.
Birch wood flowers taste sweet.
Under the bark, something sweet.
My blue wings landed before I thought.
Don't bump me; my wing dust falls.
You nearly fanned me off course.

lines.zh: 桦木林里，蓝色一飘就没了。
lines.en: In the birch woods, blue flickers and is gone.
My left wing is bent.
The birch wind is cooler than the flower field.
Blue scale dust sprinkled all over you.
Half the blue dust fell off my wings.
You take the path; I take the treetops.
Your shoulder is harder than birch.
You knocked the birch leaves down.
We'll take turns guarding the eggs.
That clearing in the wood is quiet.
Can you hear my wings hum?
Until the birches bare, only you.
My blue wings open and close like breathing.
Fly this birch stand with me.

lines.zh: 两只蓝翅，绕着同一朵花。
lines.en: Two blue wings circling one flower.
Let me circle you once.
Are your wings blue too?
This birch belongs to us two.
I'll trade you a piece of birch bark.

lines.zh: 桦木林的白皮，衬得我更蓝。
lines.en: Against birch bark, I look bluer.
So blue—it suits me.
Pressed under the birch roots.

lines.zh: 桦木林的光斑里，我一闪而过。
lines.en: I flicker through the birch light.
I could trade this to a bee for honey.
Tucked under my wing, I'll carry it.
Held under my wing, it's heavy.
I know the flowers of the birch woods.
This pollen might be useful.

lines.zh: 桦木林里，我停在你肩上。
lines.en: In the birch woods, I land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 白桦树皮的颜色，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the birch bark's color.
One bite, and I'm fed till dusk.
Blue wings flicker in the birch wood.
Wings folded, I drop straight down.
It didn't see me. Don't speak.
My compound eyes have it pinned.
It's perched and still.
Only one chance to land.
Wings folded, I fix on it.

lines.zh: 哪棵桦树有洞，我都知道。
lines.en: I know which birches have holes.
Not the shallows. Too much light.

lines.zh: 桦叶响一声，我就近一步。
lines.en: Each birch-leaf rustle brings me closer.

lines.zh: 桦木林上头，我的蓝翅膀最亮。
lines.en: Above the birches my blue wings shine brightest.
Three turns around the tree—I drop lower.

lines.zh: 十五的权重，我本就少见。
lines.en: Weight fifteen—I am already rare.
This birch wood is my patrol.

lines.zh: 你碰落的花粉出卖了你。
lines.en: The pollen you knocked loose betrayed you.
I know the smell of birch bark.

lines.zh: 花丛里的距离，我算得很准。
lines.en: In the flowers I measure the gap precisely.

lines.zh: 我这小翅膀，也只够撞一下。
lines.en: These little wings only manage one bump.
Don't touch the branch I rest on.
You'd touch my birch-tree kin?

lines.zh: 白桦林的影子，落在我翅上。
lines.en: Birch shadows fall on my wings.
Blue wings, brighter than any flower.
The edge of my wing can cut.
In this birch wood, I decide.
Did you taste it? Salty.
A faceful of blue wing dust.

lines.zh: 蓝色的翅，扇一下就是警告。
lines.en: Blue wings: one beat is a warning.
I'll hide under a petal.

lines.zh: 花海的风，把我吹到这儿。
lines.en: The flower-field wind blew me here.
The birch wind is just cool enough.
That flower field — I know it.
Footsteps at the far end of the birches.
The flower field is too bright. Dizzy.

lines.zh: 蓝翅刚展开，还皱成一团。
lines.en: My blue wings just unfurled, still crumpled.
I lift off the petal, weightless.

lines.zh: 白桦叶一翻，我就出来了。
lines.en: A birch leaf turned—and out I came.
This sea, I fly one circuit first.
My blue scales got smoked grey.
My wings lost the wind—I fell.

lines.zh: 花海的花蜜，我还没喝够。
lines.en: I haven't drunk my fill of nectar.
The blast flipped me over.
A thin dart went through my wing.
My blue wings tremble, and won't stop.
Birch sap isn't enough for me.
Lightning struck the water; my wings still tingle.

lines.zh: 往下掉，翅怎么也张不开。
lines.en: Falling, and my wings won't open.
